newsitem.title: USA: Vermont Yankee nuke restart postponed to weekend.
newsitem.headline: Vermont Yankee nuke restart postponed to weekend.

text.p: Restart of the Vermont Yankee nuclear power plant was pushed back to this weekend from Thursday because the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) needed more data on the facility, the operator said.
"We're holding off on starting the plant until they complete their review...so we'll likely start up over the weekend," a spokesman for Vermont Yankee Nuclear Power Corp said Thursday.
The agency wanted more data to evaluate whether the 510 megawatt (MW) Vermont Yankee station in Vernon, Vt., was complying with federal regulations.
"The NRC needed more information about our fire protection program. We'll being sending it in today," he said.
The facility was shut in early September for refueling and maintenance.

Vermont Yankee is owned by a consortium of New England utilities including Central Vermont Public Service Co (31.3 percent), New England Electric System (20), Green Mountain Power (17.9), Northeast Utilities (16) and Central Maine Power Co (4.0).
